segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Hi, this is Dana at Northlake Dental Group. I’m trying to get a copy of our March invoice, invoice 48291 I think, for $1,248.00. It didn’t hit our ap inbox.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yeah, I can take a look. Can I get the account email or workspace ID?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sure, workspace is NLD-2047, and the email is billing@northlakedental.com.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Okay, I see the account. March 1 invoice, due March 15, $1,248.00 for 24 seats. For invoice copies I’m going to send you over to our billing queue, they can resend that from the billing tool.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Oh, okay. I thought support could just email it, but yeah, that’s fine.

segments.speaker: Billing Agent
segments.text: Hi Dana, this is Marcus. I have the account pulled up. You need invoice 48291 sent to billing@northlakedental.com, right?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That’s right. If you can also cc dana.lee@northlakedental.com, that would help.

segments.speaker: Billing Agent
segments.text: Yep, done. I resent the PDF and the payment link to both addresses. It should arrive in the next couple minutes.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. And just confirming there’s no late fee on that yet?

segments.speaker: Billing Agent
segments.text: Correct, no late fee. It’s marked net 15, and you’re still within the grace period through March 20.

segments.speaker: Billing Agent
segments.text: No problem. I’ll note ticket 73618 that the invoice was resent and copied to you.
